avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce anastrozole plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if needed and consult oncologist

avoid_supplements.name: Red Clover
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Contains isoflavones with estrogenic activity; may counteract anastrozole's aromatase inhibition and hormone suppression
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated in hormone-sensitive breast cancer; avoid completely

avoid_supplements.name: Black Cohosh
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potential estrogenic or estrogen-modulating effects may reduce therapeutic benefit in estrogen-dependent cancers
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; discuss non-hormonal alternatives for menopausal symptoms with oncologist

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase anastrozole concentrations; effect generally mild with seed extract vs. juice
caution_supplements.action: Limit intake; monitor for increased adverse effects (joint pain, hot flashes) and report to provider

caution_supplements.name: Calcium and Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: No direct interaction, but anastrozole increases osteoporosis risk; supplementation may help mitigate bone loss
caution_supplements.action: Encouraged as supportive therapy; coordinate dosing and timing with other medications

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase anastrozole plasma levels and adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit products; switch to alternative citrus fruits (oranges, lemons)

caution_foods.name: Soy-based Products
caution_foods.mechanism: Soy isoflavones have weak estrogenic properties; high intakes may theoretically reduce anastrozole benefit
caution_foods.action: Moderate consumption is generally acceptable; excessive intake (>2-3 servings/day) should be limited and discussed with oncologist

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: No direct pharmacokinetic interaction, but may increase hot flashes and joint pain; increases osteoporosis and liver stress risk
caution_foods.action: Limit to ≤1 drink/day for women; monitor tolerance and discuss with healthcare provider

monitoring_notes: Anastrozole is used in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer; interactions that restore estrogen signaling are of critical concern. Monitor bone density, lipid panel, and cardiovascular status routinely, as anastrozole increases these risks independent of interactions.
